title: Counting subalgebras of $\mathfrak{o}^n$
summary: Let $\mathfrak{o}$ be a compact discrete valuation ring and $n\geq 2$. We introduce a method to study the cotype zeta function of subalgebras of $\mathfrak{o}^n$. This multivariable series encodes the number of finite-index subalgebras $Λ$ of the $\mathfrak{o}$-algebra $\mathfrak{o}^n$ of a given elementary divisor type. We express this zeta function as a finite sum of $\mathfrak{o}$-adic integrals and compute these integrals in many cases.
